parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.73) between `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.returnsV2WhenFeatureFlagIsV2` and `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.clearingOverrideRevertsToFeatureFlag` is characteristic of test methods that exercise related but distinct behavioural scenarios — feature-flag activation versus override clearing — within the same test class. Merging or abstracting these methods risks obscuring the distinct intent of each test case and coupling unrelated assertions. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where all participating records are test fixtures warrants no-action.
